name: Omnicomprensive Learning (Mythic)
body:
You learned to take the maximum out of all your favored classes.

Prerequisite(s): Two or more favored classes, at least one among Mythic Eclectic, Mythic Fast Learner, Mythic Favored Prestige Class, or Mythic Multitalented Mastery.

Benefit(s): Every time you gain a level in a favored class, you receive all the favored class bonuses you would have access to for gaining a level in all your favored classes.
